svg.title: Bus driver — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as bus driver, wearing a work uniform. Visible work cue: A tall front-view bus has a broad windscreen, two low headlights and two short visible tyres. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a tapered face.
